# Jiwon Kim's Blog

Jiwon Kim's Blog is a Korean technical blog about backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, architecture, operations, and troubleshooting.

## Site

- Home: https://andrewkimswe.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/andrewkimswe
- Sitemap: https://andrewkimswe.github.io/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://andrewkimswe.github.io/feed.xml

## Main Topics

- Backend API design
- Cloud architecture
- AWS deployment and operations
- Incident reviews
- Engineering documentation

## Posts

- [[AWS] S3에서 PII를 자동 탐지하고 삭제를 방지하기 - Macie + EventBridge + Object Lock](https://andrewkimswe.github.io/posts/s3-pii-detection-macie-object-lock.html): An event-driven security automation pattern using Amazon Macie, EventBridge, Lambda, and S3 Object Lock Legal Hold to protect PII objects before security review.
- [[AWS] 이미지 업로드 병목 제거하기 - S3 Presigned URL과 Lambda로 Event-Driven Processing 구성](https://andrewkimswe.github.io/posts/s3-presigned-url-lambda-image-processing.html): An event-driven image upload architecture using S3 Presigned URLs, S3 Event Notifications, and AWS Lambda.
- [[AWS] 글로벌 S3 아키텍처 구성하기 - Multi-Region Access Point와 Cross-Region Replication](https://andrewkimswe.github.io/posts/global-s3-mrap-cross-region-replication.html): A global S3 architecture note that separates MRAP request routing from CRR data replication.
- [[AWS] CloudFront 뒤의 ALB를 Private하게 구성하기 - VPC Origins](https://andrewkimswe.github.io/posts/cloudfront-private-alb-vpc-origins.html): A CloudFront VPC Origins architecture that keeps an ALB private and reduces direct origin access.
- [[AWS] CloudFront 설정 변경을 실시간으로 탐지하고 알림 보내기](https://andrewkimswe.github.io/posts/cloudfront-logging-change-detection.html): A CloudTrail, EventBridge, Lambda, and SNS pattern for detecting CloudFront logging configuration drift.
- [[AWS] Multi-Tenant Data Lake에서 Tenant 데이터 격리하기 - S3와 Lake Formation Row-Level Security](https://andrewkimswe.github.io/posts/s3-data-lake-lake-formation-row-level-access-control.html): A B2B SaaS tenant isolation pattern using S3, Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation Data Filters, and Athena.
- [[AWS] Lambda 반복 호출을 Step Functions Map으로 분리하기 - Serverless Orchestration 설계](https://andrewkimswe.github.io/posts/lambda-step-functions-map-orchestration.html): A serverless orchestration design that moves loops, retry, error handling, and concurrency control from Lambda code into Step Functions Map.
